summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the minutes of its Extraordinary General Meeting held on June 8, 2026. The meeting resolved on a reformulation of the company's bylaws, including amendments to numerous articles to reflect a new Shareholders' Agreement, governance improvements, and adjustments related to committees. Shareholders representing 97.77% of common shares and 68.61% of preferred shares attended. The filing is a routine corporate governance report from a Brazilian foreign private issuer, analogous to a US proxy or meeting minutes filing. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is indicated.
